'''Trellev Aquem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who served as a [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Aquem secretly received bribes from the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], an underworld criminal organization, and after he accidentally discovered that his [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] senatorial [[Aide/Legends|aide]] [[Jovel Nial]] had a talent for [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]], he put her talents to use in service to the Pykes.<ref name="UABS" />
